t: This is Buckingham Street, a short street in Westminster laid out on the site of York House, the London home of George Villiers, first Duke of Buckingham. Development began in 1673, and the streets around it were all named in his honour. He was a courtier and statesman, a patron of the arts, and a favourite of James the First, who stayed in royal favour under Charles the First until he was assassinated. Most of the houses here are original late seventeenth-century ones, and Samuel Pepys the diarist lived at numbers 12 and 14.
